payload.description_html:
Mackerel Fishing

Title: Mackerel Fishing (Norwegian: Makrelfiske)
Series Title: Lisbeth Bergh’s Norwegian Educational Illustrations. The series of class room wall charts consists of a total of 12 images.
Creator: Lisbeth Bergh (1861–1927), Norwegian drawing teacher and illustrator
Image Type: School chart, educational wall chart, educational illustration, class room wall chart, educational picture board, teaching material, visual aid used in object-based teaching
Description: Paper with chromolithography. Text: L. Fehr’s Lith. Officin. Christiania. ; Lisbeth Bergh: Norske Anskuelsesbilleder ; Forlagt av H. Aschehoug & Co. (W. Nygaard) 1913; Lisbeth Bergh 1913. The illustration depicts mackerel fishing in Norway around the year 1900. Fishermen, wearing sou’westers and oilskins, pull nets ashore from a rowboat with oars and a barrel. The net, full of mackerel, has cork floaters. One fisherman lifts fish with a landing net. On the beach stands a large wicker basket with fish. In the background, a steamship, a sailing boat, and small wooden houses can be seen in the coastal landscape.
Date of Origin: 1913
Location of publication: Oslo, Norway
Copyright: The material is free of copyright according to the Royal Library of Denmark (Det Kongelige Bibliotek)
